note: 'the great dragon was hurled down-that ancient serpent called the devil and Satan' (Rev 12:9). Four names in one clause, and the graph records the identification without saying which is the proper name.

'that ancient serpent called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world' (Rev 12:9); 'that ancient serpent who is the devil and Satan' (Rev 20:2). Stated twice and as an identification both times.

'I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.' (Rev 22:13); the speaker names himself Jesus at 22:16. At Rev 1:8 the same words are said by 'the Lord ... the Almighty', which the graph does not resolve.
